company.name: FlexWash Technologies
company.shortDescription: FlexWash Technologies is a car wash point of sale with a CRM and Marketing capabilities built in
company.description: FlexWash is a modern car wash POS system designed to streamline operations, grow membership revenue, and simplify daily management. Our all-in-one car wash software combines point-of-sale, CRM, marketing, and membership tools without the need for third-party add-ons. With real-time reporting, mobile handhelds, and LPR integration, FlexWash gives operators everything they need to run faster, smarter washes. Unlike legacy car wash point of sale systems, FlexWash is built for speed, ease of use, and flexibility across express, flex, and full-service formats. It adapts to your unique workflows and scales as your business grows. Car wash operators choose FlexWash to replace outdated software and unlock better insights, smoother transactions, and higher profitability.
